decisions.rationale: Sooty brick house, 7.5 x 11 m, eaves 4.3 m, parapet gables with two end chimneys to 9.0 m, slate roof; 638 triangles, 55,384 bytes before meshopt. Walls stay inside the oriented-box collider below 3 m and eaves overhang at most 0.78 m above it (check-kit: OK); baked AO at 48 samples.
limitations: Brick is a 2 m tiled layer; corners have no brick bond turning the corner, so the tile can read at 18 m.
Parapet copings are flat boxes without kneelers.
Surfaces are tiled 2 m layers shared by the whole kit; there is no unique wear, grime gradient or decals per building.

decisions.rationale: In Cinderwell (Ash Steppe) at gameplay cameras (18-40 m, pitch 0.38-1.13): reads at true scale beside the 2.25 m soldier, the 2.7 m captain and the 3.9 m boss; shadows ground it on the relief; the 1.6-3.2 m architecture cutaway keeps the hero visible behind it, and a camera inside its bounds (plus 2 m) hides it instead of showing the hollow inside.
limitations: Not enterable: interiors are not modelled.
Lighting is the overcast day grade only; windows never light up.
